Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.

content.text: I will first identify the states that have both male and female legislators with retention rates above zero for the first decade of service, at intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their initial term. A legislator is counted as retained if they are still in service on December 31 of the given year. My approach will be to first determine the first term start date for each legislator, then check their service status at these specific yearly intervals, and finally, aggregate this data by state and gender to filter for states meeting the specified retention criteria for both groups.

args.sql:
WITH FirstTermStart AS (
    -- Step 1: Determine the first term start date for each legislator
    SELECT
        id_bioguide,
        MIN(term_start) AS first_term_start
    FROM city_legislation.main.legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
LegislatorGender AS (
    -- Step 2: Get the gender for each legislator
    SELECT
        id_bioguide,
        gender
    FROM city_legislation.main.legislators
    WHERE gender IN ('M', 'F')
),
RetentionChecks AS (
    -- Step 3: For each legislator, check retention at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 years
    SELECT
        lt.id_bioguide,
        lg.gender,
        lt.state,
        fts.first_term_start,
        DATE_PART('year', fts.first_term_start) + 0 AS year_0,
        DATE_PART('year', fts.first_term_start) + 2 AS year_2,
        DATE_PART('year', fts.first_term_start) + 4 AS year_4,
        DATE_PART('year', fts.first_term_start) + 6 AS year_6,
        DATE_PART('year', fts.first_term_start) + 8 AS year_8,
        DATE_PART('year', fts.first_term_start) + 10 AS year_10
    FROM city_legislation.main.legislators_terms lt
    JOIN FirstTermStart fts ON lt.id_bioguide = fts.id_bioguide
    JOIN LegislatorGender lg ON lt.id_bioguide = lg.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide, lg.gender, lt.state, fts.first_term_start
),
RetentionStatus AS (
    -- Step 4: Determine if the legislator was retained at each interval
    SELECT
        rc.id_bioguide,
        rc.gender,
        rc.state,
        -- Check for year 0
        MAX(CASE WHEN '''' || rc.year_0 || '-12-31'''' BETWEEN term_start AND term_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_0,
        -- Check for year 2
        MAX(CASE WHEN '''' || rc.year_2 || '-12-31'''' BETWEEN term_start AND term_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_2,
        -- Check for year 4
        MAX(CASE WHEN '''' || rc.year_4 || '-12-31'''' BETWEEN term_start AND term_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_4,
        -- Check for year 6
        MAX(CASE WHEN '''' || rc.year_6 || '-12-31'''' BETWEEN term_start AND term_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_6,
        -- Check for year 8
        MAX(CASE WHEN '''' || rc.year_8 || '-12-31'''' BETWEEN term_start AND term_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_8,
        -- Check for year 10
        MAX(CASE WHEN '''' || rc.year_10 || '-12-31'''' BETWEEN term_start AND term_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_10
    FROM RetentionChecks rc
    JOIN city_legislation.main.legislators_terms lt ON rc.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY rc.id_bioguide, rc.gender, rc.state
),
StateGenderRetention AS (
    -- Step 5: Calculate retention rates for each state and gender
    SELECT
        state,
        gender,
        SUM(retained_0) > 0 AS retained_gt0_0,
        SUM(retained_2) > 0 AS retained_gt0_2,
        SUM(retained_4) > 0 AS retained_gt0_4,
        SUM(retained_6) > 0 AS retained_gt0_6,
        SUM(retained_8) > 0 AS retained_gt0_8,
        SUM(retained_10) > 0 AS retained_gt0_10
    FROM RetentionStatus
    GROUP BY state, gender
)
-- Step 6: Final selection of states meeting the criteria
SELECT state
FROM StateGenderRetention
WHERE gender = 'M' AND retained_gt0_0 AND retained_gt0_2 AND retained_gt0_4 AND retained_gt0_6 AND retained_gt0_8 AND retained_gt0_10
INTERSECT
SELECT state
FROM StateGenderRetention
WHERE gender = 'F' AND retained_gt0_0 AND retained_gt0_2 AND retained_gt0_4 AND retained_gt0_6 AND retained_gt0_8 AND retained_gt0_10
ORDER BY state;
